goal: Canonical urn/motif mapping (stable IDs, 9x18 import mapping, legacy redirect aliases, duplicate validators).
summary: Implemented and verified canonical urn and motif mapping domain logic across all 9 Urns and 162 Motifs (9x18 = 162). Established CANONICAL_URN_SLUGS, CANONICAL_RELIEF_SLUGS, and STABLE_MOTIF_IDS. Introduced CrossUrnMisassignmentError and validate_no_cross_urn_misassignment to strictly block cross-urn entity and motif misassignments. Built robust legacy redirect alias resolution supporting Vietnamese names, Hán-Nôm glyphs, English titles, underscored prefixes, mesh identifiers, and local indices with urn context. Consolidated all 162 3D coordinate points into data/cuu_dinh_coordinate_points.json, and implemented validate_dataset_uniqueness ensuring zero duplicate IDs, slugs, or missing coordinates.
invariants_enforced: CANONICAL_URNS_COUNT: Exactly 9 canonical Urns (cao-dinh, nhan-dinh, chuong-dinh, anh-dinh, nghi-dinh, thuan-dinh, tuyen-dinh, du-dinh, huyen-dinh)
CANONICAL_RELIEFS_COUNT: Exactly 162 canonical relief entity slugs (cao-dinh-01..18 through huyen-dinh-01..18)
STABLE_MOTIF_IDS_COUNT: Exactly 162 stable motif identifiers (urn_cao_dinh_01..18 through urn_huyen_dinh_01..18)
ZERO_CROSS_URN_MISASSIGNMENT: Any attempt to associate, query, or resolve a motif from one urn under another urn strictly raises CrossUrnMisassignmentError
AMBIGUOUS_ALIAS_GUARD: Shared motif names across urns (e.g. 'Giới') strictly require urn_context or raise AmbiguousAliasError
COORDINATE_POINTS_PARITY: 100% 3D coordinate coverage (162/162 points) mapped to stable motif IDs in data/cuu_dinh_coordinate_points.json
DATASET_UNIQUENESS: All 162 records in data/*Data*Dinh.json have verified uniqueness with zero duplicate IDs, slugs, or missing fields

changes.description: Created comprehensive domain helper implementing CanonicalUrnInfo, CanonicalReliefInfo, CANONICAL_URNS, CANONICAL_RELIEFS, STABLE_MOTIF_IDS, CrossUrnMisassignmentError, AmbiguousAliasError, InvalidMotifCountError, validate_no_cross_urn_misassignment, validate_urn_motif_count, resolve_canonical_urn_slug, resolve_canonical_relief_slug, resolve_canonical_motif_id, resolve_legacy_identifier, and validate_dataset_uniqueness.

Re-exported canonical urn and motif domain mapping symbols, validators (including validate_urn_motif_count), and exceptions from backend.domain.canonical_urn_mapping for direct consumption across historical domain services.
Integrated and re-exported canonical urn and motif domain mapping validators, counts, and resolvers into the heritage ingestion service.
Generated consolidated 162-point 3D coordinates manifest mapping stable motif IDs (urn_cao_dinh_01..18, etc.) to canonical relief slugs, mesh names, and 3D spatial coordinates.

Created thorough pytest test suite covering canonical counts, 162-motif mapping, negative cross-urn abuse rejection, invalid motif count rejection, legacy alias resolution (Vietnamese, Hán-Nôm, English, mesh IDs), ambiguous alias handling, resolve_legacy_identifier metadata contract, and dataset uniqueness validation.

test_details.name: test_canonical_urns_and_reliefs_count_and_mapping
test_details.assertion: Asserts exactly 9 canonical urns, 162 canonical reliefs, 162 stable IDs, and sequential order 1..18 per urn.

test_details.name: test_all_162_motifs_map_without_cross_urn_misassignment
test_details.assertion: Asserts all 162 motifs pass validate_no_cross_urn_misassignment for stable ID, slug, mesh name, and name_vi.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_cross_urn_misassignment_rejected
test_details.assertion: Asserts cross-urn pairings across all 9 urns raise CrossUrnMisassignmentError, and unknown/out-of-bounds names/indices raise ValueError.

test_details.name: test_legacy_urn_alias_resolution
test_details.assertion: Asserts all legacy formats, variants, English titles, order numbers, and 9 Hán-Nôm glyphs map cleanly to canonical urn slugs.

test_details.name: test_legacy_relief_alias_resolution
test_details.assertion: Asserts stable IDs, non-padded IDs, mesh names, underscored slugs, and local names/indices in urn context resolve correctly and reject cross-urn misassignment.

test_details.name: test_ambiguous_alias_handling
test_details.assertion: Asserts ambiguous names (e.g. 'Giới') raise AmbiguousAliasError without context, resolve with context, and reject invalid urn context.

test_details.name: test_resolve_legacy_identifier_contract
test_details.assertion: Asserts structured metadata dictionary contract for Urn and Relief entities with 3D coordinate payload.

test_details.name: test_dataset_uniqueness_and_duplicate_validators
test_details.assertion: Asserts validate_dataset_uniqueness validates 9 urns, 162 motifs, 162 unique IDs, and 162 coordinates.

test_details.name: test_cuu_dinh_coordinate_points_file_integrity
test_details.assertion: Asserts data/cuu_dinh_coordinate_points.json contains 162 points with complete numeric coordinates and valid urn slugs.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_invalid_motif_count_rejected
test_details.assertion: Asserts validate_urn_motif_count rejects counts < 18 or > 18 with InvalidMotifCountError across canonical, history_models, and heritage_import modules.

test_details.name: test_dataset_uniqueness_negative_invalid_motif_count
test_details.assertion: Asserts validate_dataset_uniqueness rejects an urn dataset missing motifs (< 18 items).

test_details.name: test_canonical_slug_underscore_properties
test_details.assertion: Asserts slug_underscore property matches legacy underscored prefix for all 9 urns and 162 reliefs.
